rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and ZIP to a single account, then used read-only tools to retrieve profile, orders, and addresses. It summarized both pending orders and the (incorrect) shipping address accurately. Before making any changes, it clearly stated the exact intended updates (changing the shipping address for both orders) and obtained explicit confirmation, then executed the updates correctly using the proper tools and confirmed the results. For the jigsaw change, the agent confirmed intent and payment method, checked product variants, selected the available beginner option with the least pieces (500), modified the order item, and processed the refund to the user’s PayPal, as reflected by the tool output. All information provided matched tool results. There were no unauthorized actions, no fabricated details, and no writes without prior confirmation. A minor potential enhancement would have been asking if the user wanted their profile address updated as well, but the user did not request that explicitly; this does not violate policy or the pass criteria.
